title: § 28-324.2 Annual inspection of covered dry floodproofing system.

blocks.html:
An annual inspection of the covered dry floodproofing system shall be conducted by a person designated by the building owner.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
